mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_approval (module, action, recordId, applicantId, applyReason, status, applyDate, detailJson) VALUES (#{module}, #{action}, #{recordId}, #{applicantId}, #{applyReason}, 0, NOW(), #{detailJson})
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.userName as applicantName FROM tb_approval a LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON a.applicantId = u.id WHERE a.status = 0 ORDER BY a.applyDate DESC
SELECT a.*, u.userName as applicantName FROM tb_approval a LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON a.applicantId = u.id WHERE a.applicantId = #{applicantId} ORDER BY a.applyDate DESC
SELECT a.*, u.userName as applicantName FROM tb_approval a LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON a.applicantId = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_approval SET recordId = #{recordId} WHERE id = #{id}
